svg.title: Galerina, SLIDE/VOK and Lyth-Weaver: components and WAT/WASM migration
svg.desc: Current compatibility route and intended primary SLIDE route, followed by grouped component roles. Bounded implementations and research are distinguished from production readiness. Source review 26 October 2026.
svg.text: ONE LANGUAGE • THREE DISTINCT RESPONSIBILITIES
Galerina + SLIDE / VOK + Lyth-Weaver
What the main components do — and exactly where the WAT/WASM execution path changes
01 CURRENT CLI / BOOTSTRAP
Executing TypeScript bootstrap retained; WAT/WASM is still the live CLI route.
.fungi source
Application and policy code
Galerina compiler
Checks → canonical GIR
WAT
WebAssembly text
WASM
WebAssembly binary
Compatibility runtime
Governed execution via the Wasm lane
WAT is a representation of WebAssembly; it is not a separate execution engine.
02 INTENDED PRIMARY PATH — THE SLIDE REPLACEMENT
KEEP the Galerina frontend and GIR. Replace mandatory WAT/WASM emission and execution after the migration gates pass.
Checked .fungi → GIR
Galerina semantic ownership
SLIDE package + checks
Realize .slide; independently verify
VOK admission role
Today: JS reference model
SLIDE execution
Runner executes; VOK does not
Terminal evidence
Result, refusal and audit receipt
REPLACEMENT SEAM: after canonical GIR
VOK is a JS reference today; production authority and migration remain open.
OPTIONAL BRANCH: GIR → WAT/WASM → separately admitted executor
Explicit compatibility / differential target; never silent rescue after refusal.
Reading the map
Roles below are source-described component families, not a claim of complete production wiring or a fresh test pass.
GALERINA
Language, application rules and governed source
SLIDE / VOK
Target realization, admission and execution
LYTH-WEAVER
Reusable proof work and research instruments
SOURCE / BOOTSTRAP
Language + compiler
.fungi is Galerina’s governed programming language.
Scanner, parser and checks validate types, effects,
value state and governance; GIR carries the plan.
GOVERNANCE
K3 logic + Tower Citizen
Three outcomes: ALLOW, DENY, INDETERMINATE.
Tower consumes identity, capability and lease evidence.
A source decision is not a downstream execution lease.
COMPOSITION
Runtime + app framework
Runtime and app kernel connect governed flows.
API adapters, application borders and audit surfaces
keep host interaction explicit and typed.
CHECKS / CONTRACTS
Memory + security + sentinels
Track ownership, value state, secrets and permissions.
Observe policy/security state and reject invalid inputs.
Host/native enforcement needs its own evidence.
MIGRATION ROLES
Tri-Pipe + Tri-Fuse
Tri-Pipe proposes compute routes and safety evidence.
Tri-Fuse discharges proved obligations; residual checks
remain. Neither proposal nor optimisation grants access.
CAPABILITY BORDERS
Target adapters + observations
CPU, native, Wasm and other target contracts describe
requested capabilities and observed hardware facts.
Device presence alone does not make it usable.
GOVERNED EFFECTS
Data, network + extensions
Database/web/network packages expose controlled effects.
SecretsProvider / .spore and native bridges sit at borders.
External engines retain separate trust and custody.
DISCOVERY / EVIDENCE
Myco, Hypha + developer tools
Myco locates material; Hypha scans passive facts.
Graphs, audits, benchmarks and tests support inspection.
An index hit or test receipt is not execution authority.
BOUNDED REFERENCE
Frontend handoff + canonical decoder
Take executable GIR, source identity and closed inputs.
Decode and validate graph, types, effects and resources.
The independent target is not limited to Galerina.
BOUNDED REFERENCE
Profiles + physical .slide packages
Select a declared representation and bind exact bytes.
Package ABI checks exports, imports and dependencies.
Independent re-derivation catches drift or substitution.
NO RELEASED PRODUCTION AUTHORITY
VOK — JavaScript reference model
Models eight admission gates, one-use leases and receipts.
Memory evidence is one gate; this is not a Rust checker.
Intended admission role; does not execute machine code.
BOUNDED REFERENCE
Nonce authority + effect broker
Track lease consumption and reserve effect attempts.
The broker mediates capability-limited host operations.
Process recovery evidence is not power-loss proof.
BOUNDED REFERENCE
Execution core + terminal receipts
Run supported admitted graphs with typed outcomes.
Bind execution, resource and audit evidence to the lease.
General native runner / production release remain open.
DESIGN / LAB MIX
DFE + Shape Fabric + VPEG
DFE: deterministic work DAG, products and publication.
Shape Fabric: replay and verify candidate graph work.
VPEG: typed graph fragments; caches confer no authority.
RESEARCH ONLY
NSE + cache-tile experiments
Neural Shape Engine proposes candidates for checking.
Cache-tile experiments study staged data movement.
Neither learned output nor speed can authorize execution.
TARGET ARCHITECTURE
Native / optional Wasm / future targets
Intended native lowering replaces mandatory WAT/WASM.
Wasm remains an explicit compatibility / oracle choice.
Broader hardware, isolation and durability gates stay open.
LAB IMPLEMENTATION
Admission-work intake
Accept a closed request and reject malformed inputs.
Results: ELIGIBLE, INDETERMINATE or REFUSED.
There is no ALLOW outcome in the proof-work result.
LAB IMPLEMENTATION
Closure key + digest envelopes
Bind source, GIR, package, verifier, policy and target.
Canonical fields and freshness identify the exact context.
Similar-looking work is not automatically reusable.
LAB IMPLEMENTATION
ReuseStore + trust-domain gate
Store or retrieve exact evidence under scoped access.
Conflicts may quarantine identities; foreign access refuses.
A store hit still requires independent SLIDE verification.
PRODUCTION GATES OPEN
DFE domain + package handoff
Proposed production custody lives in a DFE domain.
Producer statements and exact packages carry evidence.
Production integration and authenticated custody are open.
EXECUTION LAB
Work/span + partition + subset
Measure work and critical path; propose partitions.
Classify where deterministic parallel work is permitted.
Authority and non-commutative effects remain ordered.
EXECUTION LAB
Algebra + capability model
Require proved algebra before reordering operations.
Model affine ownership and allowed use of capabilities.
Structural lab checks do not contain hostile native code.
EXECUTION LAB
Weaver interpreters + adapters
Compare serial and strand-based execution with SLIDE.
Bridge bounded flow plans into research instruments.
This comparator is separate from the primary fabric.
MEASUREMENT / LAB
A-lane harness + assurance tools
Measure whether proof-work reuse actually pays off.
Mutation tests, capability lint and drift checks probe gaps.
Research results never mint a VOK execution lease.
HOW THEY CONNECT
Intended roles: Galerina checks meaning → Lyth supplies optional proof work → SLIDE verifies → VOK gates permission → SLIDE runner executes.
STATUS: current compatibility lane + bounded reference implementations + explicit design/lab work. No production admission is implied.
WASM replacement ≠ removal of .fungi, GIR, governance or hybrid cryptography. No automatic fallback; no removal before the named gates pass.
Sources: Galerina README + current-flow map; SLIDE README, migration plan, VOK foundation design + .mjs source; Lyth README + ARCHITECTURE + schema.ts.
Reviewed 26 Oct 2026 • Galerina a26c070444dc • SLIDE 514737141a16 • Lyth-Weaver 15dcd2dc19d8 • Main component families, grouped for readability.
